objective: Find and validate one genuinely working strategy with sustainable positive after-cost expectancy and useful frequency.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Asset-specific momentum remaining after removing broad market movement may persist because idiosyncratic information and flows diffuse gradually.
candidates.hypothesis: Residualized cross-sectional momentum has positive incremental after-cost expectancy across predeclared liquid universes and chronological splits.
candidates.blocker: Frozen cheap screen DISC-RESIDUAL-MOMENTUM-001-v1 produced 0/2 passing Top-15/Top-30 pre-OOS subsets on exact artifact 10572498750; challenger training rank IC and 3x after-cost spread were negative on both subsets. Historical point-in-time membership is unverified, so the screen is exploratory negative evidence only: keep OOS locked, do not deep-freeze, and do not terminally reject solely from survivor-biased evidence. Pivot to the next materially distinct clean-data screen.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Volatility expansion after compression can persist when new information, leverage adjustment, or liquidity withdrawal creates directional order-flow imbalance.
candidates.hypothesis: A predeclared compression-to-breakout rule with volatility-scaled exits has positive after-cost expectancy outside its training period.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Short-lived liquidity shocks and forced order flow can temporarily dislocate price from its local equilibrium, followed by partial mean reversion when liquidity replenishes.
candidates.hypothesis: A predeclared liquidity/volatility shock filter identifies short-horizon mean-reversion opportunities with positive after-cost expectancy.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Trend-following EMA geometry may capture persistent directional order flow if the exact published rules are applied consistently across assets and timeframes.
candidates.hypothesis: The exact user-specified Frizz/PlayBit EMA rules exhibit robust after-cost expectancy on a subset of assets/timeframes without post-hoc rule changes.
candidates.blocker: Exact indicator source/rules must be pinned and fingerprinted before any screen; do not approximate or silently substitute the existing FFRIZZ family.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Extreme moves may share measurable pre-move combinations of liquidity, leverage, supply, narrative, catalyst, and market-structure conditions.
candidates.hypothesis: Matched-control big-move studies can generate measurable precursor hypotheses that improve future strategy discovery without using post-move information.

candidates.economic_mechanism: Liquidity, credit, policy, capital-flow and positioning changes can transmit into asset returns through measurable causal channels.
candidates.hypothesis: Money Intelligence can generate timestamp-defensible, testable strategy hypotheses with incremental predictive value over simple price-only baselines.
